glossEn: to take a person away illegally

derivation: ab-（离开）+ duct（引导）→ 把人带走
example: The suspect is accused of abducting a child.

glossEn: the act of carrying someone away by force
derivation: ab + duct → 带走
+ -ion → 带走的行为
example: Abduction carries a heavier penalty than theft.

glossEn: a person who takes someone away illegally; a muscle that pulls a limb away
derivation: ab + duct → 带走
+ -or（施动者）→ 实施者
example: Police arrested the abductor at the border.

glossEn: to gain entry to data or a place
a device that moves or controls something

ety.from: act（拉丁 agere“做”）+ -uate + -or
ety.note: act → actuate → actuator 的逐层派生，机器人语域指驱动关节的装置。

ety.from: advertisement 的截短形式
ety.note: 19 世纪报刊口语截短。

glossEn: a word thrown alongside a noun

ety.from: artificial intelligence 的首字母缩写
ety.note: 1956 年达特茅斯会议后成为学科名称。

ety.from: 中古拉丁 algorismus，源自 9 世纪数学家花拉子米（al-Khwārizmī）的名字
ety.note: 原指“用阿拉伯数字计算的方法”，后泛指解题步骤；现代计算机义是 20 世纪的专门化。

ety.from: 希腊 analysis（拆解），ana-（向上、分开）+ lysis（松开）

glossEn: a channel built to carry water

derivation: aque（水）+ duct（引导）→ 引水的通道
example: The Roman aqueduct still carries water into the city.

glossEn: an underground layer that holds water

derivation: aqui（水）+ fer（携带）→ 带水的地层
example: The aquifer beneath the plain is slowly being depleted.

glossEn: one side of a matter; look
etymology: 拉丁 aspectus < ad-（朝向）+ specere
derivation: a（朝向） + spect（看） → aspect
example: Cost is only one aspect of the decision.

glossZh: 自主的；自治的；自动驾驶的

ety.from: 古英语 egefull（充满敬畏的），ege 恐惧 + -full
ety.note: 原义“令人敬畏的”，19 世纪口语中弱化为“糟糕的、极坏的”，并发展出加强副词用法。

glossZh: 双语的；会说两种语言的

ety.from: bio-（生命）+ -logy（学科），源自希腊语

glossEn: to scatter seed widely, hence to transmit widely

ety.from: broad（广泛）+ cast（撒、投）的复合词
ety.note: 原为农业术语“撒播种子”，20 世纪广播技术借用为“向大众播送”。

ety.from: breakfast + lunch 的混成词
ety.note: 19 世纪末英国校园俚语，取 breakfast 的首部与 lunch 的尾部拼合。

ety.from: 中古英语 bugge（昆虫；鬼怪），确切来源有争议
ety.note: “程序错误”义在 20 世纪 40–70 年代的计算语境中定型，与“虫子”义是同一词的隐喻扩展；词源细节仍有争议，不宜细说年代。

glossEn: to adjust an instrument against a standard
the act of adjusting an instrument to a standard
coal-bearing; of the Coal Measures period
derivation: carboni（碳、煤）+ fer（携带）+ -ous（形容词后缀）→ 含煤的
地质学专指石炭纪
example: The Carboniferous strata contain extensive coal seams.

etymology: 拉丁 circumferentia < circumferre（环绕运送）
derivation: circum-（环绕）+ fer（带）+ -ence（名词）→ 绕行一圈的长度
example: The circumference of the circle is about six centimeters.

etymology: 拉丁 circumspectus < circum-（环绕）+ specere
example: Be circumspect when quoting preliminary numbers.
derivation: circum（环绕） + spect（看） → circumspect
circum（环绕） + spect（看） + ion（名词后缀） → circumspection
example: Circumspection is required before publishing the map.

ety.from: 古英语 clūd（岩块、土丘）
ety.note: 本义指“岩块、丘”，中古英语转指天空中的云团（与 clod 同源分化）；“云计算/云端”是 21 世纪初的隐喻扩展。

etymology: 拉丁 comportare < com-（共同）+ portare（携带）
derivation: com（共同） + port（运送） → comport
example: The findings comport with earlier field data.

derivation: com（共同） + port（运送） + ment（名词后缀） → comportment
example: Her comportment in the lab was always calm.

glossEn: to lead or carry out; to transmit heat or electricity
the ease with which a material carries electric current
derivation: con + duct → conduct 传导
+ -ance（名词后缀）→ 传导的能力
example: We compared the conductance of the two thin films.

glossEn: the passing of heat or electricity through a material
etymology: 拉丁 conductionem < conducere < com- 'together' + ducere 'lead'
derivation: con-（共同）+ duct（引导）→ conduct 引导、传导
+ -ion（名词后缀）→ 传导过程
example: Thermal conduction through the wall was measured with two sensors.

glossEn: able to carry heat, electricity or sound
glossZh: 导电的；导热的；能传导的
derivation: con-（共同）+ duct（引导）→ conduct
+ -ive（形容词后缀）→ 有传导性质的
example: The paste keeps the joint conductive as it cures.

glossEn: a measure of how well a material carries electricity or heat
derivation: con + duct + -ive → conductive
+ -ity → conductivity（-ive + -ity 合为 -ivity）
example: We measured the conductivity of the electrolyte at three temperatures.

glossEn: to grant or bestow; to consult
etymology: 拉丁 conferre < con-（共同）+ ferre（带）→ 带到一起
derivation: con-（共同）+ fer（带）→ 带到一起→ 商议
→ 把荣誉带到某人身上→ 授予
example: The university will confer an honorary degree on her.

etymology: 中世纪拉丁 conferentia < conferre（商议）
example: The annual conference drew researchers from twelve countries.
derivation: confer（商议）+ -ence（名词后缀）→ 商议的场合

etymology: 拉丁 conformare < con-（共同）+ forma（形状）
example: The housing must conform to the IP67 standard.
derivation: con（共同） + form（形状；形成） → conform
con（共同） + form（形状；形成） + ation（名词后缀） → conformation
example: The protein's conformation changed with pH.

derivation: con（共同） + form（形状；形成） + ist（从事者） → conformist
example: He was too much of a conformist to challenge the plan.

derivation: con（共同） + form（形状；形成） + ity（名词后缀） → conformity
example: Conformity with the spec is checked at intake.

etymology: 拉丁 conifer < conus（锥）+ ferre（结）
derivation: coni（锥）+ fer（携带）→ 结球果的树
example: Conifers dominate the higher slopes of the range.

derivation: coni（锥）+ fer（结）+ -ous（充满……的）
example: The coniferous forest shelters little ground vegetation.

glossEn: to build or form by putting parts together
etymology: 拉丁 construere < con-（共同）+ struere（堆叠）→ constructus
example: The team constructed a scale model of the bridge.
derivation: con（共同） + struct（建造） → construct

glossEn: the act of building; something built

ety.from: 拉丁 constructio（堆叠、建造），经古法语 construction 进入英语
ety.note: con-（共同）+ struere（堆叠）的过去分词词干 struct-；-ion 是拉丁名词后缀。

example: Construction of the tunnel took four years.
derivation: con（共同） + struct（建造） + ion（名词后缀） → construction
con（共同） + struct（建造） + ive（形容词后缀） → constructive
semanticShift: “建造的” → 有益的、建设性的

derivation: con（共同） + struct（建造） + or（施动者） → constructor
example: The class constructor sets the default values.

glossEn: a binding agreement; also to shrink
to come together toward a point
a connection between parts or systems

ety.from: central processing unit 的首字母缩写

derivation: de-（向下、从……引出）+ duce（引导）→ 从前提中引出结论

derivation: de-（向下、离开）+ duct（引导）→ 从中引走一部分
example: The fee is deducted from the first payment.

glossEn: able to be subtracted from taxable income; (n.) the amount paid before insurance
derivation: de + duct → deduct 扣除
+ -ible → 可被扣除的
example: The policy carries a five-hundred-dollar deductible.

glossEn: an amount taken away; a conclusion reached by reasoning
derivation: de + duct → 引走
+ -ion → 扣除的行为/扣除额；由前提引出的结论
example: The deduction from the invoice covered shipping.

glossEn: reasoning from general rules to particular cases
derivation: de + duct → 引出
+ -ive → 由一般引出个别的
example: A deductive proof starts from axioms and derives each step.

derivation: defer（推迟）+ -ment（名词后缀）

Strain gauges recorded plastic deformation.

de（去除；向下） + form（形状；形成） + ed（过去/被动） → deformed

derivation: de（去除；向下） + form（形状；形成） + ity（名词后缀） → deformity

derivation: de（反向；去除） + struct（建造） + ive（形容词后缀） → destructive
de（反向；去除） + struct（建造） + or（施动者） → destructor

glossEn: the process of teaching and learning
derivation: e + duc → 引出

example: Public spending on education rose again this year.

glossEn: relating to education; serving to teach
derivation: e + duc + -ation → education
+ -al（形容词后缀）→ 与教育有关的
example: The kit has real educational value for beginners.

glossEn: a person whose job is to teach
derivation: e + duc → 引出
+ -ator（施动者）→ 从事教育的人
example: The award honours rural educators.

ety.from: examination 的截短形式

derivation: ex（向外） + spect（看） + ancy（名词后缀） → expectancy；ex- + spect → expect，s 脱落

example: The expectant crowd waited for the first image.

derivation: ex（向外） + spect（看） + ation（名词后缀） → expectation；ex- + spect → expect，s 脱落
example: The result fell short of expectation.

glossEn: to send goods to another country

example: The firm exports sensors to twelve countries.
derivation: ex（向外） + port（运送） → export
ex（向外） + port（运送） + able（可…的） → exportable
example: The design is exportable without modification.

derivation: ex（向外） + port（运送） + er（者） → exporter
example: The exporter must attach a customs declaration.

glossEn: able to produce abundant growth or offspring

glossEn: the capacity to produce crops or offspring

example: Soil fertility declined after decades of monoculture.

glossEn: to enrich soil; to make fruitful

glossEn: a substance added to soil to increase yield

derivation: form（形状；形成） → form

derivation: form（形状；形成） + al（形容词后缀） → formal

derivation: form（形状；形成） + al（形容词后缀） + ist（从事者） → formalist

derivation: form（形状；形成） + al（形容词后缀） + ity（名词后缀） → formality
example: The inspection is a formality, but it is recorded.

derivation: form（形状；形成） + al（形容词后缀） + ize（使…） → formalize
example: We formalized the safety check as a written step.

derivation: form（形状；形成） + al（形容词后缀） + ly（副词后缀） → formally
example: The agreement was formally signed in June.

derivation: form（形状；形成） + ation（名词后缀） → formation
form（形状；形成） + ative（形容词后缀） → formative

derivation: form（形状；形成） + less（无…的） → formless

ety.from: geo-（地球）+ -logy（学科），源自希腊语

glossEn: relating to heat from the earth

ety.from: gymnasium 的截短形式

ety.from: 古英语 hāligdæg（圣日），holy + day 的复合词

glossEn: to receive guests; to run a service

glossEn: relating to electricity generated by water

glossEn: condition of abnormally low body heat
something placed under as a basis
